skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Spring Vouivre
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Spring Vouivre. Completely handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this stylish outfit combines comfortable materials with cutting-edge tech and traditional handicraft. Custom-made services are also provided in order to achieve the highest practicability and style.
skins.quote: Beauty is also important in battles.

skins.name: Overload
skins.content: Striker Series/Overload. A product of Raythean Industries, a combat outfit fully tailored to exceptional specialist personnel. Offers reliable defense in all environments, further supports the Operator's own Originium Arts.
skins.usage: One part of Liskarm's tactical equipment.
skins.quote: An arc and thunder, dividing ally from enemy.
